strategy_definitions.D: stratified k-means (2H.7): sklearn KMeans(k = share, n_init=1, seeded) on the pool; one production-weighted pick per cluster
strategy_definitions.E: numpy k-means: numpy k-means++ seeding + Lloyd until stable (max 20); one production-weighted pick per cluster; empty clusters filled by production-weighted picks from the rest of the pool
strategy_definitions.F: PC1 quantile strata: equal-count strata along the pool's first principal component; one production-weighted pick per stratum
strategy_definitions.shared: same eligibility, exact shares, top pool_multiplier x share pool and interleaving as production

selection_rule: simplest prototype (F, then E) passing every gate on the exploratory seeds; held-out seeds only re-check the gates

latency_definitions.harness p95 (gate): summary.latency_ms: every call in the 50-run harness, as in Phases 2H.6/2H.7
latency_definitions.first_call_in_run: first call of the strategy in this already-warm process
latency_definitions.steady_state: all harness calls except the first
latency_definitions.cold_start: fresh interpreter per measurement (5 processes), catalog loaded first (untimed); first, second and tenth sad/match call

speech_like_definition: share of served tracks with speechiness > 0.66; calm_requests = mean over ['chill / match', 'stressed / uplift'] (both are calm-only requests)
notes: Diversity is feature-space diversity (mean pairwise distance in the 9 z-scored audio features), not perceived musical diversity.
Precision/NDCG are omitted: relevance is the eligibility definition, so they are 1.0 for every strategy.
Bootstrap intervals resample one request's runs; they describe sampling variability only.
Latency is machine-dependent; strategies were run sequentially in one process.
